abstract: The endodermal sinus tumor of the ovary is a rare and highly lethal germ cell tumor. At least 10 different names have been applied to it, and so long as its name remains unsettled the collection of information will continue to be greatly impeded. One of the patients who came under our observation died after 21 months despite surgical removal of all evident disease followed by radiation and chemotherapy; the other patient, whose tumor could be removed only partially, and who received intensive chemotherapy for 4 months but refused all treatment thereafter, is well without evidence of disease 3 years after the initial diagnosis was made. Despite the dismal outlook for patients with this tumor, a few encouraging features emphasize the need to report new cases as they appear, and to continue the search for agents that will control it.
abstract_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍は、稀で致死率の高い胚細胞腫瘍である。この腫瘍には少なくとも10の異なる名称が与えられており、名称が定まらない限り情報収集は大きく妨げられる。当施設で経過観察した患者の1例は、明らかな病変のほぼ全てを外科的に切除した後に放射線療法と化学療法を受けたが、21か月後に死亡した。もう1例は腫瘍の一部のみ切除可能であり、4か月間の集中的化学療法を受けたのち、以後の治療を拒否した。この患者は初診時の診断から3年後も病変の証拠なく良好な状態である。予後は厳しいものの、新症例の報告を続け、本腫瘍に有効な薬剤を探索する必要があることを示す明るい特徴も見られる。
